notes: Degree adjective of size with no supporting figure; cut the intensifier.
Rule 5 exemplar word dramatically used as a placeholder for how much the architecture changed; no magnitude is given.
Absolute-extent intensifier with no count or source; cut universally.
Increasingly is a vague more-and-more intensifier standing in for an unstated rate or share.
Rapidly stands in for an unstated growth rate; no percentage or capacity figure appears in the essay.
Dramatically pads I²R loss reduction; nearby kV ranges explain why current falls, not by how much losses fall, so cut rather than replace.
Increasingly asserts a trend without a rate, outage count, or other evidence.
Severity intensifier on failures already identified as the 2021 Texas storm and 2022 India blackouts; cut the padding adjective.
Unprecedented is a degree claim of novelty; the 30–120 samples/second figure is already in the same sentence, so cut the intensifier rather than replace.
Massive is a scale intensifier in a heading; Millions of rooftop PV installations follows in the same bullet, so cut rather than duplicate via replace_with_fact.
Profound intensifies transformation with no measurable depth or share of change.
